item: the test job installs original-awk and gawk so the two launcher awk tests run, and lists skip reasons in the pytest summary
summary: tests/test_launcher_records_race.py::test_the_filter_records_under_the_one_true_awk skips unless original-awk is on PATH, and tests/test_launcher_stderr.py::test_the_filter_gives_the_same_record_under_every_awk_it_may_meet skips unless two of mawk, gawk, original-awk and busybox are. The skip-reason audit (2026-10-29) found both skipping locally with mawk alone, which is what the runner image is inferred to carry. The test job now installs original-awk and gawk in a step after the tesseract step. original-awk alone is enough to un-skip both tests (mawk plus original-awk is the stderr test's two); gawk adds a real third implementation to its comparison. gawk registers itself as the awk alternative at priority 10 against mawk's 5 (original-awk at 0), so a bare install would move every other launcher test and every shell script from mawk to gawk; the step records readlink -f /usr/bin/awk first, restores it with update-alternatives --set awk, and prints what was installed before and the default before and after. The update, the install and a command -v on each of the two binaries are separate lines: under GitHub's bash -e a failing command inside an && chain does not stop the step, so a failed apt-get update would otherwise leave it green with nothing installed and both tests skipping again without a sound (simulated with stubs: update failing exits 100, binaries missing exits 1, the happy path exits 0). The same job's pytest line gains -rfEs: pytest's -r replaces its default fE instead of adding to it, so -rs alone would have dropped the FAILED and ERROR lines from a red run's summary (measured on a scratch file: -q prints FAILED and ERROR, -q -rs prints only SKIPPED, -q -rfEs prints all three); with -rfEs each skip's file, line and reason is in the log in a grouped block before the result line and the result line and exit status are unchanged. Measured on a scratch tree with the two awks on PATH: the two launcher files give 98 passed, 4 skipped (the four are pwsh) against 96 passed, 6 skipped with mawk alone, and the 16 test files that read ci.yml pass with the step in it (496 passed, 32 skipped). Stated limits: not measured on a runner, so whether the image already carried gawk or busybox is read from the step's own first line in the PR run, not from here; the step fails if /usr/bin/awk is not a registered alternative (Ubuntu images register mawk), which is a loud red rather than a silent change; the skip-count delta of the test job is read from the PR run's pytest summary. Evidence: /mnt/project-files/export-lane/awk-step-2026-10-29/MEASURED.md.
